body: I wouldn't want to _always_ include the junction table in the association queries. However, if the association has non-empty conditions, we could contain() the junction table.

Oh sure I definitely agree on that. I've tried tracing the code, and I think the problem is going to be _where_ exactly to add the `contain()`. If I had a good suggestion, I'd offer a PR like last time, but I'm stumped right now. Any suggestions on where to look?
I would probably start by overloading `BelongsToMany::find()`.

issue.body:
When proxying finder methods from a belongstomany association, if that association has conditions we should contain the junction table as the conditions very likely use columns on that table.

Refs #7707

rename.from: belongsToMany [condition]s can't (always) utilize fields from the glue table.
rename.to: belongsToMany [condition]s can't (always) utilize fields from the junction table.
